# Bad graphics file references
# Demonstrates GFX001 (ported from pychivalry PR #56's events/test_gfx_validation.txt).
# Checked against the mock base game (src/test/fixtures/mock-ck3-game): without a base game
# nothing is reported, since a miss cannot be proven.

namespace = test_gfx

# Event with missing graphics
test_gfx.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = test_gfx.0001.t
	desc = test_gfx.0001.desc

	# This background file does NOT exist
	# ERROR: GFX001
	background = "gfx/interface/backgrounds/missing_background.dds"

	option = {
		name = test_gfx.0001.a
		# This icon file does NOT exist
		# ERROR: GFX001
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/missing_icon.dds"
	}

	option = {
		name = test_gfx.0001.b
		# The same missing file again: reported once per file, at its first reference
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/missing_icon.dds"
	}
}

# Event with existing graphics and non-path values (no warning)
test_gfx.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = test_gfx.0002.t
	desc = test_gfx.0002.desc

	# A bare name is a key into another database, not a file
	icon = standard_character_event

	option = {
		name = test_gfx.0002.a
		# In the base game's game/ folder
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/mock_base_icon.dds"
	}

	option = {
		name = test_gfx.0002.b
		# In a game/dlc/<dlc>/ folder, written in another case
		icon = "GFX/Interface/Icons/Mock_DLC_Icon.DDS"
	}

	option = {
		name = test_gfx.0002.c
		# Filled in at run time
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/$ICON$.dds"
	}
}
